description: A tuple constructor in parentheses is not a static list
notes: The spec makes tuple construction syntax a static list without saying whether parentheses around it, which only group in evaluation, keep it one. hashicorp/hcl keeps the parentheses as a ParenthesesExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), which has no ExprList method and can't be unwrapped, so hcl.ExprList reports an error.
reference_error: A static list expression is required
